description: Ember Bridge is led by Ryan, a full-stack builder and data analyst (data, web, design). We’re tackling MODIS/VIIRS Hot Spots: NASA’s two fire satellites disagree, faking a jump in wildfires after 2012. We’ll build one consistent 25-year fire record for Canada, as open data and an interactive map. Clear plan from day one, real NASA data at the core. Looking for: remote sensing/GIS, data science/ML, video & storytelling. Must be registered at the same local event.
